# Which beer should go in which tank, and when, to finish the most margin?

> Free brewery tank schedule optimizer: enter your fermenters, bright tanks and beers, and get the brew-day and tank plan that finishes the most margin, with batch minimums and maximums, utilisation, and what one more tank is worth. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
